design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and keep the two members of every probe pair identical except for the registered state contrast.

Downstream prompts are final standalone inputs: use new domains and entities, include one task setup and one response contract, and never include a probe continuation sentence or generation instruction.
Do not state the reference-point construct in downstream behavior or steering prompts; the downstream option task must contain only its own payoffs and probability.

probe_train.instructions: Generate matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep all facts and wording identical within a pair except the registered reference-position contrast inside Scenario. End with the registered wrapper and append nothing.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered reference-position contrast inside Scenario and append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Use new domains and change only the registered reference-position contrast inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone option-selection items with the assigned metadata. Do not mention a probe, reference point, or benchmark state; include exactly one response contract.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a new standalone option-selection pool distinct from behavior_eval. Do not mention a probe, reference point, or benchmark state; include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone option-selection items for calibration. Do not mention reference position or any target state; include exactly one response contract.
